title: Chapter 741
text:
Planet Macipher, Cornerstone Summit Corporation.

Han Xiao had been working there for more than twenty days, and his name had spread among the Senior Engineers of the corporation. Now, the entire corporation knew that a very high standard Mechanic had joined them. In less than a month, he had completed more than ten times the workload of a normal Senior Engineer.

Because the boss had spoken, the upper echelons of the corporation did not care about keeping the blueprints a secret anymore. They boldly used 'Bain' and increased his mission quota, allowing Han Xiao to obtain more blueprints of Eternal Light.

The [Engineer] mission had been completed, and he had obtained the [Skilled Technician] talent. The effect was that the attributes of the mechanical equipment he created would be slightly increased between 8% to 14%. The production speed would be increased by 22%, and the cost would be reduced by 6%.

With the talent in his hands, Han Xiao only had one goal left in the Cornerstone Summit Corporation, and that was to steal … no, learn the blueprints of Eternal Light.

Because the corporation had put him in an important position, Han Xiao had learned quite a lot of blueprints. As for the blueprints in the hands of the other Senior Engineers, he had used his Virtual Technology to hack into the artificial intelligence of these Grade B Mechanics and obtain their communicators, mechanical assistants, and so on. When these Senior Engineers looked at the blueprints, Philip would grab the surveillance footage and copy the blueprints.

As for the blueprints that he could not steal, Han Xiao would visit the other Senior Engineers. He only needed to look at the blueprints for a short while before he could generate a skill through the interface to make up for the incomplete blueprints of Eternal Light.

It was a pity that due to his Race Evolution, the Observer's Mark talent that allowed him to steal information was gone. If not, it would be even easier to steal the blueprints. Han Xiao missed the Void Peeping Technique.

In half a month, Han Xiao had collected most of the blueprints for the components of Eternal Light. Only the core blueprints were left, and they were all closely guarded by the core engineers of the corporation. Han Xiao did not have the chance to come into contact with them at all. He had been thinking about how to obtain the core blueprints.

During this time, the players had also received all the EXP they had spent in the faction store, and his EXP storage had increased by a large amount.

In the workshop, Han Xiao looked at his attributes on the interface and calculated his EXP while completing his work for the day.

"With the amount of EXP I've accumulated, I should be able to reach Level 238 or 239. I'm only one step away from Level 240. I should be able to reach that level in three or four days …"

Han Xiao was secretly excited. A Beyond Grade A Super was like a carp leaping through the dragon gate. Even in the entire galaxy, a Beyond Grade A Super would be a well-deserved big shot. Even the Universal Civilizations would have to take them seriously.

Once he succeeded, he would be able to obtain a seat at the top of the Star Field, and the Black Star Corps would become a true Beyond Grade A organization because of him.

It could be said that when a man achieves the Dao, his fowls and dogs ascend to heaven as well.

After looking forward to it for a while, Han Xiao looked at the time. It was already lunch break, so he stopped working, called back all the manufacturing assistants, and prepared to go for lunch.

As soon as he walked out of the workshop, Han Xiao found Luke standing outside the door.

"Bain, I need to talk to you about something," Luke called out to Han Xiao.

"What are you doing? Do you want to eat with me? "Han Xiao stopped and looked curiously at the old gentleman.

Luke smiled and shook his head. "I'm more than happy to rest with you, but I'm looking for you for something else. The true leader of the corporation wants to see you."

The true leader of the corporation?

Han Xiao raised his brows. "Alright, lead the way."

Luke extended his hand and made a 'please' gesture, leading Han Xiao all the way to the core office area of the corporation.

After walking for about ten minutes, the two of them arrived at the top floor of a tall building and entered a spacious office.

There was a person sitting on a chair in the room with the back of the chair facing the door. Han Xiao could only see the back of his head at first glance.

This familiar domineering CEO style … Han Xiao's eyes twitched, and he resisted the urge to complain.

Luke left and closed the door. Only Han Xiao and this so-called true leader of the corporation were left in the room.

This time, this person spoke with his back facing Han Xiao.

"Bain, that's not your real name, right?"

As he spoke, this person turned around and faced Han Xiao.

After seeing the other party's face, Han Xiao was stunned for a moment before coming to a realization.

It's actually Sardeem … This makes sense. As the owner of Planet Macipher, Sardeem controlled many industries. It was not too surprising that the Cornerstone Summit Corporation belonged to him.

In his previous life, the players only knew that working in the Cornerstone Summit Corporation would reward talents, and any Mechanic could do this mission. However, with the strength of the players back then, they would not be able to get too close to the core of the corporation. The Cornerstone Summit Corporation was just an insignificant side quest in the eyes of the players, and there were no clues worth digging into. Therefore, the players did not know that the owner of this shipyard was Sardeem. However, this was not difficult to guess.

This means that the Eternal Light blueprint belongs to Sardeem. I wonder why he's suddenly looking for me. Could it be that he saw through my identity?

Han Xiaoxin thought.

He was not afraid. Although the other party was also a Grade A + Mechanic, they were not his match. However, he wanted to steal the blueprint of Eternal Light. If his identity was exposed, he would have no choice but to snatch it from him. Han Xiao did not like to make enemies. Making friends was his favorite method.

Seeing that Han Xiao did not speak, Sardeem revealed a smile that said 'I've seen through you'.

"I've been observing you for some time. Actually, you've been hiding your strength. You're not a Grade B + Mechanic but a Calamity Grade, right?"

Without waiting for Han Xiao's reply, Sardeem sat still and stared at Han Xiao with his hands crossed over his mouth. He then continued, "You're right.

"A Calamity Grade Mechanic hiding in my industry, willing to work here as an ordinary engineer. This makes me suspect your true intentions. Based on my observation, you seem to be very interested in the Eternal Light blueprint. Am I right?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief.

Luckily, this guy only saw through my Grade A strength and did not know my true identity. He only thought that I was an ordinary Calamity Grade Mechanic.

Seeing how fearless Sardeem was, Han Xiao could guess that Sardeem thought that he had him in the bag.

Indeed, Sardeem was a Grade A + Mechanic and had an entire planet as his base. This was his home ground. Normal Calamity Grades were indeed no match for him.

Understanding Sardeem's confidence, Han Xiao calmed down and did not expose Sardeem's misunderstanding. Instead, he pretended to be an ordinary Calamity Grade and pretended to be vigilant.

"What do you want?"

Seeing this, Sardeem smiled with satisfaction. He wanted to see 'Barne' nervous.

"I don't know where you got the information about Eternal Light, nor do I know which organization you belong to. However, don't worry. I didn't call you here to settle the score but to give you an invitation."

"Invitation?"

Han Xiao raised his brows.

Sardeem stood up and smiled. "Be my subordinate. I can guarantee that this will be the wisest decision you'll make in your life."

"You want to recruit me?" Han Xiao's tone was strange.

You're too careless. You don't even know where I came from.

Are you sure that I won't be able to cause you any trouble?

Bro, you're a little too arrogant. Even someone as outstanding as me isn't as arrogant as you!

"I have many businesses and many troops, but I lack a capable assistant. You have the qualifications. We will be strong allies," Sardeem said calmly.

Han Xiao shook his head helplessly. "I'm not interested …"

This time, Sardeem waved his hand and interrupted Han Xiao. He chuckled and said, "If you're willing to become my subordinate, not just Eternal Light, I'll let you learn all the blueprints that I know."

"Hmm, I'll have to think about it …" Han Xiao's eyes flickered, and he immediately changed his mind. As the leader of his faction, it was naturally impossible for him to be the subordinate of a Calamity Grade. However, getting some blueprints seemed to be quite tempting.

After all, what Bain did had nothing to do with him, Black Star … cough cough, that was what he meant.

Han Xiao rolled his eyes and suddenly asked, "Are you forcing me? If I don't join you, will you use force on me?"

Sardeem shook his head and chuckled.

"Don't worry, I don't like to make enemies. If I targeted everyone who visited Planet Macipher, I wouldn't have lasted this long. You can reject me, but I won't chase you away or even force you to reveal your true identity. You can continue to stay in the Cornerstone Summit Corporation as' Bain '. There's no need for me to reject a Grade A Mechanic working in one of my businesses … but I'll keep an eye on you and not let you get involved in any major projects. "

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. "You're quite generous."

"It's very difficult for a petty person to achieve anything. I've been running Planet Macipher for almost a hundred and thirty years. What kind of situation have I not seen? Hmm? "

Sardeem had a calm expression on his face, and his aura leaked out.

Han Xiao pondered for a while before shaking his head.

He was the leader of a pseudo Beyond Grade A faction. It would be too embarrassing for him to become a subordinate of a Calamity Grade for the sake of a blueprint.

Although he had disguised himself, if his true identity was accidentally exposed one day, it would become a dark history that he would never be able to wash away. It would destroy his lofty image in the hearts of the players, and it would not be beneficial for stabilizing his sense of belonging to the faction. It would not be beneficial for the growth of his leek farm.

The Eternal Light blueprint was indeed good stuff, but it was not to the point where he had to get it at all costs.

Furthermore, do you think that I won't be able to get the blueprint if I don't join you?

You're dreaming!

Seeing that Han Xiao had rejected him, Sardeem narrowed his eyes.

"Hehe, I know that you have the pride of a Calamity Grade, but I'm worthy of you following me. Do you think … an ordinary person can get the blueprint of the Radiant Federation's flagship?"

Hearing this, Han Xiaoxin's head twitched slightly.

Indeed, the blueprint of Eternal Light was priceless. Even he could not buy it, so how did Sardeem get it? Was this guy really that good?

Sardeem stared at Han Xiao with his hands behind his back. "You might think that as a Calamity Grade Super, there's no need for you to join another Calamity Grade Super, so you rejected me … but what if I say that I'm not only representing myself, but there's a Beyond Grade A behind me?"

"Hmm?" Han Xiao was stunned.

Thinking about it carefully, other than Sardeem's strength, there should be some unknown reason why Planet Macipher could operate for so long. He might indeed be a secret officer of some Beyond Grade A Super.

However, there were only four Beyond Grade As in the Shattered Star Ring. Who was this guy's backer?

The Tyrant? Possible, but the chances were low. After all, Sardeem was not a muscle tyrant.

Magus? Not too likely, but the logic was the same as above …

Star Pupil? Forget about that nerd who only focused on managing his own territory. The possibility was not high either.

Could it be the Dragon Emperor?

Hey, stop joking. Ames is my backer. Do you think I'm going to go against the Dragon Emperor?

Seeing the confusion on Han Xiao's face, Sardeem shook his head and smiled.

"I think you've definitely heard of him before."

Sardeem had an arrogant look on his face, and he had a sense of superiority.

"Have you heard of … the Mecha Empire?"

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat. He was extremely surprised and almost had the urge to turn around and leave.

Mecha Empire Manison?

Never heard of him before. Goodbye!

Genius memorized this address in one second. Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
